title: Angular-Go Extract i18n Builder
description: Extracts i18n messages from source code.

browserTarget.description: A browser builder target to extract i18n messages from in the format of `project:target[:configuration]`. You can also pass in more than one configuration name as a comma-separated list. Example: `project:build:production,es5`.

outFile.description: Name of the file to output (e.g. messages.xlf).
